Input inside the label is wrong on both semantical and W3c aspect.
"we do not have to be Bootstrap compliant" <- No, we have to be compliant with EVERYTHING (so, seek an destroy this kind of small incompatibility).
Your proposition break the logic (User just added tittle of his facets, he won't understand why labels are not supported for a simple select) + it's made to be easy so if I have to read the doc to make a valid markup, it's not cool.
